summary: 旅游能创造收入，也会改变地方文化、资源分配和居民与游客的权力关系。九组矛盾说明，同一次开发给不同群体带来的结果可能相反。
logic: 游客与当地人相遇，引出九个矛盾
真实体验、借贷与生态成本
文化如何变成商品，旅游收入流向哪里
迎合外来游客如何改变治理和文化保护
谁承担投资风险，谁掌握旅游发展的权力

paragraphs.brief: 相遇双方带来的旅游悖论
sentences: International tourism presents itself as straightforward, passive and benign, yet it is complex, interesting and important, full of contradictions and depths.
国际旅游给人的印象是简单、被动而无害，但实际上既复杂又重要，充满耐人寻味的矛盾和深意。
Tourism is the world’s largest export, yet it is ephemeral, produced within an encounter, usually fleeting, between host and guest.
旅游业是世界上最大的出口，但只是短暂的，是在东道方和客人之间通常短暂的交汇中生产的。
It has enormous growth potential; almost every country desires an expansion in this sector.
它具有巨大的增长潜力；几乎每个国家都希望扩大这一部门。
Yet whether and how to grow is not nearly as straightforward as one might hope.
然而，是否和如何成长却不如人们所希望的那么直截了当。

Because each tourist and each native brings along a unique jumble of expectations, knowledge, power, and aspirations, multiplying tourist encounters transforms the tourist and the native, and can permanently alter the social and political contexts in which they live.
因为每个游客和每个本地人都带来一团独特的期望、知识、权力和愿望，成倍增加的旅游遭遇改变了游客和本地人，并且可以永久改变他们生活的社会和政治环境。
When these personal encounters increase in number, they have extensive and complicated consequences for cultures, natural environments, and politics as well as local and international economies.
当这些个人遭遇增多时，对文化、自然环境、政治以及地方和国际经济产生广泛而复杂的后果。
paragraphs.gist: 国际旅游看似轻松无害，实际是游客与当地人在短暂相遇中共同产生的出口体验，不同参与者各有所求，使旅游扩张很难简单判断。

paragraphs.brief: 游客的选择也改变当地
sentences: When people who are so different—who believe they are so different, as we do not go to visit ourselves—brush up against each other, they exchange more than cash.
当不同的人——他们以为自己是不同的人——像我们不去拜访自己一样——互相磨擦，他们交换的钱比钱还多。
Tourism always contains a message: this is what we value, this is what we don’t.
旅游业总是包含着一个信息：这就是我们所珍视的，这是我们所没有的。
Tourists come to see some things and not others; they vote with their money but also with their feet and their eyes and ears.
游客来看东西，而不是其他东西；他们用自己的钱投票，但也用他们的脚和眼睛和耳朵投票。
Local people look back, and change as a result.
当地人回头看，结果就改变了。
Natural sites and ceremonies change in response to the presence of tourists.
自然地点和仪式因游客的出现而改变。
paragraphs.gist: 游客用目光、脚步和消费表明什么值得看，当地人又会对这份关注作出回应，连原本的自然景点和仪式也会随之改变。

paragraphs.brief: 扮演传统角色与现代生活并存
sentences: Studies of tourism often describe contradictions.
对旅游业的研究往往描述矛盾。
Men who dress as native warriors at work go home to microwaves and VCRs.
工作时穿当地武士服的男人回家去用微波炉和录像机
Before television news interviews, Amazonian Indians dress in body paint and feathers, a costume they have never before even seen, to increase their aura of authenticity.
亚马孙地区的原住民在电视新闻采访前涂上身体彩绘、戴起羽饰，哪怕从未见过这种装束，也要藉此显得更“原汁原味”。
Twists and contradictions operate both within and between the areas usually marked out as disciplinary property.
在通常被标为纪律财产的地区内部和之间都存在矛盾和矛盾。

In studying a tourist encounter, we can integrate information about income with insights about language and cosmology to better understand the tourist encounter’s depth and subtlety while retaining analytical precision and attention to the particular detail.
研究游客与当地人的一次相遇，可以把收入资料同语言、宇宙观方面的认识结合起来，在保持分析严谨、关注具体细节的同时，理解这次相遇的多重含义。

Studying specific tourist sites or particular encounters complicates generalizations about victimization and control, authenticity, the desires of those involved, the priority of material interest, and the nature of culture.
研究特定旅游点或特定旅游点会使关于受害和控制、真实性、有关人员的愿望、物质利益的优先次序和文化性质的概括化变得复杂。
paragraphs.gist: 工作时扮武士、回家用现代家电的人，以及为电视采访才披上羽饰的人，都说明个别旅游相遇会动摇人们对“真实文化”的简单判断。

paragraphs.brief: 九个旅游悖论的开场
sentences: Here are nine of tourism’s paradoxes:
以下是九点旅游悖论：
paragraphs.gist: 作者接下来列举国际旅游的九个悖论。

paragraphs.brief: 真实体验为何须借人为展示
sentences: By definition, tourists travel to see and knowingly to encounter the different, the original, the authentic.
从定义上说，游客旅行是为了亲眼见到和有意识地接触与日常不同、独特而真实的事物。
In this globalizing world, what they want is regional and unique.
在这个全球化世界中，他们想要的是区域性和独特的。
Only through display and packaging are they confident about what is worthy of attention.
只有通过展示和包装，他们才对值得关注的东西有信心。
As Dean MacCannell explains in The Tourist, there must be an obvious front to an attraction; only by going through it into the “back” do tourists know themselves to be in the zone of the authentic.
正如Dean MacCannell在《旅游者》中解释的那样，吸引必须有一个明显的前台；只有穿过这个后台，游客才知道自己在真实的地带。
Natural sites, too, need to be framed.
自然遗址也需要加以界定。
Gates, permits, and interpretive texts set them apart from the mundane.
盖茨，许可，和解释文本把它们与平凡分开。
Complicated framing and staging allow tourists to recognize, by sight, “the actual thing.”
复杂的设置和摆放使游客能够目视地认出“真实的东西”。
Of course, living culture and the natural world are characterized by being integral, not at all separated.
当然，活文化和自然世界的特点是不可分割，而不是完全分离。
sectionTitle: 1. Only through artifice can locals meet the tourist demand for authenticity.
1. 当地人只有借助人为设计，才能满足游客对“原汁原味”的期待。
paragraphs.gist: 游客希望遇见真实独特的事物，却常要借包装、门票、解说和展示才知道什么值得看，就连自然景点也需要人为界定。

paragraphs.brief: 发展旅游基础设施由谁出资
sentences: Tourism can provide the ideal export for developing countries, which avoid debt by capitalizing on what they already have: a unique culture, a singular natural environment, and a definite place in world history.
旅游业可以为发展中国家提供理想的出口，发展中国家通过利用它们已经拥有的东西来避免债务：一种独特的文化、一种独特的自然环境，以及在世界历史中的确切位置。

Countries can, however, capitalize on what they already have only if they already have airports, hotels, major sanitation facilities, local transportation, hydroelectric plants, and medical facilities.
但是，只有拥有机场、旅馆、主要卫生设施、当地交通、水电站和医疗设施，各国才能利用它们已经拥有的东西。
If not, the government faces a choice.
否则，政府将面临一个选择。
It could build them itself.
它可以自己造出来

The financing would come from foreign lenders, placing the country in debt, or come from local tax revenue, making local people pay for major infrastructure and services that will only be used by outsiders.
融资来自外国贷款人，使该国处于债务状态，或来自当地税收，使当地人民为主要基础设施和服务支付费用，而这些基础设施和服务只能由外来者使用。
Or the government could allow others to build.
或者政府可以允许他人建造。
With foreign investment, the country relieves itself of providing capital, but forgoes profits.
接受外资，国家就不必自己筹措建设资金，但相应的利润也会让给别人。
sectionTitle: 2. To capitalize on what you already have, you must borrow.
2. 想从原有资源中获益，先得借钱。
paragraphs.gist: 发展中国家看似可用现有资源吸引游客，却先得筹资兴建机场、酒店等设施，自己出资可能举债或动用税收，接受外资则须让出利润。

paragraphs.brief: 用生态游客的支出保护资源
sentences: Environmental degradation results from tourism as well as from general human activity.
环境退化是旅游业和人类一般活动造成的。
Ecotourism developed as a way to prevent and reverse this damage.
生态旅游的发展是预防和扭转这种破坏的一种方式。
Ecotourists distance themselves from mainstream hotel tourists, and also from adventure tourists like those who have, famously, fouled the base of Everest.
生态游客有意与住常规酒店的大众游客划清界限，也与那些探险游客保持距离；曾把珠穆朗玛峰大本营弄得污秽不堪的人就是一个著名例子。
They pay to sleep in tents on platforms in tropical rainforests, to swim along reefs, to walk over a tree canopy on a net bridge.
他们花钱睡在热带雨林平台上的帐篷里，沿珊瑚礁游泳，在网桥上走过树冠。
They value the ecosystem as it is and are willing to pay for its preservation.
它们珍视生态系统，因为它是而且愿意为保护生态系统付出代价。
In this way, they create an incentive for local people to refrain from using natural resources for short-term gain.
这样一来，就鼓励当地人民避免利用自然资源来获取短期利益。
sectionTitle: 3. What is environmentally sustainable is often unprofitable and insulting.
3. 有些做法能维持生态可持续性，却往往无利可图，还会冒犯当地人。
paragraphs.gist: 生态游客愿意付费体验保持原貌的雨林、珊瑚礁等生态系统，使当地人有动力保护资源，避免为了眼前收益而开发它们。

paragraphs.brief: 限制客流与营地收入的矛盾
sentences: What is fortunate for the birds is not always so fortunate for the local people.
鸟儿的幸运并非总是对当地人如此幸运。
In order to be environmentally sustainable, ecotourists have to be few in number.
为了在环境上可持续，生态旅游者的人数必须很少。
The economies of scale that allow tourism to be profitable cannot operate in a small bush camp.
使旅游业盈利的规模经济无法在一个小灌木营中运作。
Camping doesn’t generate much revenue.
露营并不产生多少收入。
Ecotourism proves that tourism does not have to be in conflict with environmental preservation.
生态旅游证明，旅游业不必与环境保护发生冲突。
Unfortunately, it also proves that the realm in which the environment and the economy can be mutually supporting is tiny.
不幸的是，这也证明，环境和经济能够相互支持的领域很小。
paragraphs.gist: 为保持生态承载力，游客数量必须有限，但小型营地又难有规模经济或丰厚收入，使生态保护与当地经济利益相合的空间有限。

paragraphs.brief: 保护自然时被忽略的居民
sentences: In addition, Westerners’ interest in biodiversity stands in contrast to their indifference to the local human community.
此外，西方人对生物多样性的兴趣与他们对当地人类社区的漠不关心形成对照。
The tourist wants to listen to a parrot, not a local elder.
游客想听鹦鹉的歌而不是本地的长辈
Dollars bypass beggars on their way to support trees.
美元绕过乞丐他们的途中支持树木。
Ecotourism can send the message that nature is more interesting and valuable than local people.
生态旅游可以发出这样的信息：自然比当地人民更有趣、更宝贵。
paragraphs.gist: 西方游客愿意花钱看鹦鹉、护树，却可能忽略当地长者和贫困者，让人感到自然多样性比当地居民更受重视。

paragraphs.brief: 传统工艺成为商品的取舍
sentences: Tourism places a premium on the parts of a culture that are visible such as handicrafts, costume, and architecture, and slides over those that are not, like the rules governing seating on a bus, assumptions about clergy, or bases for legitimate authority; in this way, tourism favors what can be commodified.
旅游更看重手工艺、服装和建筑等看得见的文化，容易略过公共汽车座次、对神职人员的看法或权威合法性的依据等隐性规则，因而偏向能够商品化的部分。
Yet commodities can be produced most efficiently using industrial machinery, taking advantage of economies of scale, an option closed to village artisans.
然而，利用工业机械，利用规模经济这一对乡村工匠封闭的选择，可以最有效地生产商品。

One way to preserve traditional crafts and folkways is to market tradition, in effect using the production process and ethnic-heritage connection as a brand name that increases the value of an otherwise uncompetitive item.
保护传统手工艺和民俗的一种方式是将传统市场化，实际上利用生产过程和民族-遗产联系作为品牌，增加本来没有竞争力的物品的价值。
sectionTitle: 4. Commodifying culture simultaneously preserves, transforms, and destroys it.
4. 把文化当作商品，既会保存它，也会改变它，甚至毁掉它。
paragraphs.gist: 旅游偏爱易展示和出售的手工艺与服饰，传统工匠又难与工业量产竞争，于是有人把传统工法及族群传承本身化作提高售价的卖点。

paragraphs.brief: 纪念品市场如何改变手艺人处境
sentences: Because souvenir stores sell baskets, weavings, carvings and preserved foods, all typically produced by women, the result of exposure to the market can be to raise the position of women relative to men, and the position of the household economy relative to that of the formal economy.
由于纪念品店出售篮子、编织品、雕刻品和保存食品，而这些都是妇女通常生产的产品，因此，与市场接触的结果可能是提高妇女相对于男子的地位，以及家庭经济相对于正规经济的地位。
It also alienates the producer from what is being produced, as mass production eschews meaning.
它还使生产者脱离生产，因为大规模生产意味着放弃生产。
When non-commodities, such as religious objects, go up for sale, not only does their status fall, but their price tags give a clear sense of the worth powerful people accord them.
当非商品，如宗教物品，上市出售时，不仅其地位下降，而且其价格标签也清楚地感觉到有权势者给予它们的价值。
paragraphs.gist: 纪念品市场能提高女手艺人和家庭经济的地位，但大规模生产或把宗教物品出售，也可能削弱制作者与作品的联系及物品原有的意义。

paragraphs.brief: 旅游支出先流向哪些企业
sentences: Tourists of every stripe give most of their money to corporations headquartered in and owned by the wealthy countries.
各类游客都把大部分钱花在由富裕国家出资、总部也设在那些国家的企业身上。
They buy airline tickets from Air France, hotel rooms from Westin, rental cars from National.
他们从法国航空公司买机票，从威斯汀酒店房间买旅馆，从National租车。
Vacationers buy their luggage, bathing suits and fishing gear at local malls and specialty shops before they leave home.
度假者在离开家之前在当地商场和特色商店购买行李、泳衣和渔具。
sectionTitle: 5. Money tourists spend to vacation in the south never reaches the south.
5. 游客为去南方度假而花的钱，却根本没有流入南方。
paragraphs.gist: 游客购买机票、酒店服务和租车时，多数钱先流向富裕国家的企业，连泳装、行李等物资也常在出发前就买妥。

paragraphs.brief: 包价套餐为何把收益留在海外
sentences: New hotel chains bring blueprints and contractors of their own, marketing departments and managers who come with the hotel.
新的连锁酒店带来了自己的蓝图和承包商、营销部门和与旅馆一起来的经理。
When tourists buy packages—inclusive meals, rental car-airline-hotel combination deals—their spending is contained, literally, within the corporate fortress, whose goal is to contain “leakage.”
游客购买含餐服务或租车、航班、住宿打包的套餐后，消费便被锁在企业体系内，这些企业力求避免收入“漏”到体系之外。
Even produce can be shipped in.
连产品都可以运进来
Ecotourism has this same potential.
生态旅游也有同样的潜力。
Package tours that pay for tents and guides through wilderness areas are labor-intensive rather than capital-intensive, but still the revenue ends up with British airlines or Canadian tour packagers.
以野外帐篷和向导服务为主的包价游更依赖人力、所需资本较少，但收入仍可能最终流入英国航空公司或加拿大旅游承办商手中。
paragraphs.gist: 连锁酒店自带承包商、经理和采购体系，包价游把消费锁在公司内部，即便依赖当地人力的生态团，收入也可能流向海外航司和旅行商。

paragraphs.brief: 外部投资对地方政治的影响
sentences: Tourism promotes an external orientation.
旅游业促进外部导向。
Like other exports, the “tourism experience” is produced by local people and consumed by foreigners.
与其他出口品一样，“旅游经验”是由当地人制作的，由外国人消费。
Unlike other exports, it is consumed in the country of production.
与其他出口品不同，它消费在生产国。
This “natural” external quality combines with international lending conditions to orient the government to foreign, rather than domestic, interests.
这种“自然”的外部质量与国际贷款条件相结合，使政府面向外国利益，而不是国内利益。
To obtain loans and ultimately create revenue, a government (of whatever size) has to please outside investors and potential travelers.
为了获得贷款并最终创造收入，政府(无论大小)必须取悦外部投资者和潜在的旅行者。
Once an airport is built, there are advantages to economies of scale, yet that prevents economic diversification, making the entire economy more dependent on a single, outward-oriented sector.
机场一旦建成，规模经济就具有优势，但这阻碍了经济多样化，使整个经济更加依赖单一的外向型部门。
In these ways, tourism lends itself to politics with an authoritarian cast.
通过这些途径，旅游业可能助长带有威权色彩的政治运作。
sectionTitle: 6. Governments pursue tourism to benefit the local people, but in the process become oriented toward outsiders and away from their citizens.
6. 政府发展旅游本为当地人谋福，但在这一过程中却逐渐转向迎合外来者，疏远自己的民众。
paragraphs.gist: 旅游体验虽在本地消费，却服务外国客人，贷款和投资条件还会把政府推向外部利益，并可能促使当局以更强硬的方式保障既有投资。

paragraphs.brief: 固定的旅游形象与活的文化
sentences: Cultural idiosyncrasies and natural spectacles change over time.
文化特性和自然景象随时间而变化。
Tourists can’t be attracted, however, to an unstable and ambiguous culture, nor to a natural site that is in the process of transforming itself.
但是，旅游者不能被不稳定和模糊的文化所吸引，也不能被一个正在自我改造的自然场所所吸引。
As a consequence, efforts are made to fix and standardize: folk dances, tortilla-making, and peace pipes, bird habitats and the course of the Amazon have all been bounded and defined.
其结果是，努力修复和规范：民间舞蹈、玉米饼制作、和平管道、鸟类生境和亚马逊河的走向都受到约束和界定。
Real life proceeds around them.
现实生活围绕他们进行
Had they not been fixed, however, they would not be accessible.
然而，如果这些设施没有固定，则无法使用。
sectionTitle: 7. Attempts to present living nature or culture to tourists (or to protect them from tourists) have the effect of deadening them.
7. 无论是向游客展示鲜活的自然与文化，还是保护它们免受游客干扰，这些努力反倒可能使它们失去活力。
paragraphs.gist: 自然景观和文化习俗本会改变，为使游客能辨识与参观，人们却常把舞蹈、手艺和栖息地固定成标准样貌，而真实生活仍在继续变化。

paragraphs.brief: 隔离游客的文化收益与经济代价
sentences: Much of the cultural change that has to be hidden comes from tourism itself.
大部分文化变化必须隐藏在旅游业本身。
Tourists look, but locals look back.
旅游者看，但当地人看回来。
They see bikinis, independent women, wasted food.
他们看到比基尼，独立的女人，浪费的食物。
They see Westerners wanting to have their pictures taken with locals, but not to pay them or offer a favor in exchange.
他们看到西方人想让当地人拍照，却不付钱或提供好处作为交换。
Insofar as culture involves subtle valuations, etiquette, and meanings, tourists at a minimum present an alternative to local culture, and at maximum a critique of it.
就文化涉及微妙的价值观、礼仪和含义而言，游客至少可以替代当地文化，并尽可能批评当地文化。

Quarantining tourists in hotels and resorts, or self-quarantining in tents, helps to avoid cultural contamination and commodification, but at an economic cost: tourist dollars never enter the local economy.
把游客集中在酒店和度假村，或由游客自行待在营地，可减少文化冲击和商品化，但经济代价是游客的钱进不了当地经济。
paragraphs.gist: 当地居民也会观察游客的服饰、行为与消费方式，把游客集中在度假村或营地虽可减少文化冲击，却也使旅游收入难以进入当地经济。

paragraphs.brief: 游客消费与税收如何惠及当地
sentences: Whoever owns and runs the main tourist industries profits.
拥有和经营主要旅游业的人将获得利润。
Visitors to and employees of hotels and museums, corporate shareholders and state officials, all can benefit.
旅馆和博物馆的访客和雇员、公司股东和国家官员都可以受益。
Prairies can suddenly become an asset.
草原会突然变成资产
Taxes levied on tourists can fund public schools, courts and police.
对游客征收的税款可以资助公立学校、法院和警察。
The tourist enjoys a luxurious holiday, and in exchange local employees, shareholders, and the state all benefit directly.
游客享受奢侈的假期，作为交换，当地雇员、股东和国家都直接受益。
Many more benefit indirectly as dollars multiply through the regional economy.
随着美元在区域经济中成倍增长，更多的间接受益。
sectionTitle: 8. Tourism is at the same time the best possible development sector and the most treacherous.
8. 旅游业可能最适合用来带动发展，同时也是风险最高的行业。
paragraphs.gist: 旅游业经营者、员工及政府都可直接获益，游客缴税能支持学校等公共服务，消费再流入地区经济时还会间接惠及更多人。

paragraphs.brief: 客流骤减和闲置设施的风险
sentences: Tourism is, however, a risky investment.
然而，旅游业是一种风险投资。
Owners have to be careful not to price themselves out of the market.
所有者必须小心，不要在市场中为自己定价。
Even unique sites compete with others.
即使是独特的网站也与其它网站竞争。
Beach or jungle countries are interchangeable in tourists’ eyes.
海滩或丛林国家在游客眼中是可以互换的。
Investments can’t be guaranteed.
投资无法保障。

Small islands and remote provinces have to maintain airports capable of handling international jumbo jets, have to create roads used mainly by tourists and have to provide fresh water for hotels, yet volume can be cut to less than half in one day, with a single hurricane, or a terrorist attack; it can peter out more slowly as a resort becomes déclassé.
小岛和偏远地区要维护能起降国际大型客机的机场，修建主要供游客使用的公路，还得为酒店供应淡水；然而一次飓风或恐袭就可能令客流在一天内减半以上，度假地也可能随潮流退去而逐渐冷清。
Empty hotels, wildlife sanctuaries, and jet-skis can’t then be turned into anything that local people need.
空置的酒店、野生动物保护区和水上摩托艇，都很难变成当地人真正需要的东西。
paragraphs.gist: 景区必须投入机场、道路和供水等专门设施，但灾害、安全事件或潮流变化都可能使客流锐减，闲置设施又难转作居民真正需要的用途。

paragraphs.brief: 扎根当地与依赖旅游的两难
sentences: When successful, countries and localities are faced with a dilemma: allow it to remain an enclave sector, limited in benefits, or force it to grow roots, extending benefits but also deepening dependence on a single, fickle industry.
成功时，各国和各地区都面临两难境地：允许它继续成为飞地部门，利益有限，或迫使它扎根，扩大利益，但也加深对单一的、易变的工业的依赖。
When unsuccessful, tourism investment is an economic loss like any other, with an added twist.
旅游投资如不成功，就会像任何其他投资一样造成经济损失，而且会增加转折。
Governments cannot declare bankruptcy, but are stuck with their losses.
政府不能宣布破产，而是要承受损失。
paragraphs.gist: 成功的旅游区可扩大本地受益范围，却也会加深对单一且易波动行业的依赖，投资失败时政府又不能用破产摆脱损失。

paragraphs.brief: 游客与居民的应对如何影响世界
sentences: When tourists encounter local people, they bring with them the weight of their expectations, their leisure and their power.
当游客遇到当地人时，他们带来了期望、休闲和力量的重负。
Locals see this, and respond: they react against it, make a counter offer, or adapt to expectations.
当地人看到这一点，并作出反应：他们对此作出反应，提出反建议，或适应期望。
This seemingly trivial exchange can have profound economic, environmental, cultural and political effects, not only on individuals but on the global political economy.
这种似乎微不足道的交流不仅对个人，而且对全球政治经济都会产生深远的经济、环境、文化和政治影响。
sectionTitle: 9. Tourism pretends to be apolitical, but it encapsulates problems of power and worth on a grand and global scale; it pretends to be passive, yet it is produced by an encounter between host and guest in which anything is possible.
9. 旅游业表面上与政治无关，却浓缩了全球范围内有关权力与价值的问题。它看似被动，实际上由东道主与游客的相遇塑造，而这种相遇可能产生任何结果。
paragraphs.gist: 游客带着期待、闲暇与购买力抵达，当地人选择抵抗、协商或迎合，这些看似微小的往来最终会影响文化、环境乃至全球政治经济。

揭开旅游的矛盾 → 经济收益与地方代价 → 文化进入商品市场 → 所有权与权力
clauses: Men … go home to microwaves and VCRs.

读到 who 时，回看 Men，再把修饰信息接回主句。
In studying a tourist encounter, we can integrate information about income with insights about language and cosmology to better understand the tourist encounter’s depth and subtlety ….
连接词 while 引出“while retaining analytical precision and attention to the particular detail”，说明主句的时间或对比关系。
先读主句的动作，再用 while 把这一层关系补进去。
